name: Process: Run the unblocking practice: the joint half-page, its window, and the refusal of a unilateral case
markdown_description:
P29 and I9. Either party to a disagreement inside another owner's range or between two owners has the duty to write; the half-page (the problem as the outcome for the customer or the house, the options, the trade-offs with the unresolved marked, by seat) sits on the leads' review record as a Class B hold or the partners' page as Class C; decided by the range's owner inside one domain, the owning domain across domains, and the founder whose domain holds the outcome or the reserved-class rule between the leads, never up a line; on the record by the next leads' review and decided with its reason within the loop-closure window; an owner asked by one party alone asks the three questions and refuses until the absent party has been asked to write, recording "declined to write" where they will not; the decision is read back on the next scorecard. A half-page about a person goes to the check-in or the flag. Extends `86akh5ufu` by reference. Normal.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
